fix.pr_body:
## What changed

TappedOut and MTGGoldfish are no longer supported integrations, so the `/link` page no longer needs to display or process their username fields.

**`decksite/templates/linkaccounts.mustache`**: Removed the TappedOut (`to_username`) and MTGGoldfish (`gf_username`) label/input/error-div blocks from the form shown to users who have already connected their MTGO account.

**`decksite/views/link_accounts.py`**: Removed `link_tappedout()` and `link_mtggoldfish()` methods and their calls from `process()`. Removed the pre-population logic that copied `tappedout_username`/`mtggoldfish_username` from the DB into the form. Simplified `process()` accordingly. Dropped the now-unused `cast` import.

DB columns (`tappedout_username`, `mtggoldfish_username`) are left in place as existing data and schema migrations are out of scope.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (exit 0)
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 687 passed, 1 skipped, 89 deselected

Fixes #12711
